findings.where: http://127.0.0.1:4175/tropos/ice (same picture set on all 8 Tropos pages) and /hemisphere/ice (all 8), desktop windows about 790 px high or more: 1440x900, 1920x970, 1440x790. Gallery: #g-next, #g-prev, #thumbs, #stage.

findings.what: The stage takes each picture's height, so the arrows, the thumbnails and everything under them jump between pictures. At 1440x900 on Tropos the Next arrow's top is at y 733, 713, 733, 733, 568, 733 for pictures 1 to 6; thumbnails top 831, 811, 831, 831, 668, 831; the Specifications heading 1005, 985, 1005, 1005, 842, 1005. (At 1440x900 this happens when the pointer is in the arrow's lower 20 px, its middle included.) At 1920x970 the arrow jumps 94 px after the first click (803 to 709) and 238 px at picture 5; the second click lands on blank paper and nothing happens: stuck at 2 / 6. No jump at 1536x730, 1280x720, 1366x768 (Core) or on the phone at 390x844, where the stage keeps one height.
